title: SplitFile
description: Frozen participant-level split of a labelled dataset (Phase 07, Task 07.8; data/splits/<dataset_version>/{test_participants.json, cv_folds.json}). README section 13: sessions of a participant are never split, participant sets are disjoint, and feature-normalisation statistics are computed per fold on TRAIN participants only (the rule Phase 08 must obey). The same files are mandatory for Phases 09-19. The number of held-out test participants and K are functions of the actual participant count P, recorded here together with the rule that produced them (ADR-0021).

split_kind.description: Which file this is. Both are produced by one call so they can never disagree; both carry the same split_hash inputs.

frozen.description: True only for a split of a participant dataset that the owner has frozen. A SYNTHETIC or DEV_CAPTURE split is never frozen: it is a self-test of the machinery.

rule_id.description: The split-design rule applied, e.g. P07-SPLIT-1 (ADR-0021 table keyed on P).

P.description: Actual number of participants in the dataset. MEASURED from the dataset manifest; 0 means no participant exists yet and no participant split can be frozen.

K.description: Number of participant-grouped CV folds on the non-test participants; 0 when CV is not possible for this P.

seed.description: Seed of the deterministic assignment; the split is reproducible from (participants, strata, seed, rule_id) alone.

stratify_keys.description: Participant attributes used to stratify the held-out set (experience, handedness) when they are collected; an empty list means no stratification was possible and that is stated in the rationale.

participants.description: All participants of the dataset, sorted.

dev_participants.description: Participants available for model selection (all participants minus test).

folds.description: Participant-grouped folds over dev_participants; empty for a TEST_HOLDOUT file with K = 0.

sessions_by_participant.description: The session grouping the split honours: every session of a participant goes wherever that participant goes.

leakage_checks.description: Machine-checked leakage properties; all_passed = false must never be written to a frozen split.

normalisation_rule.description: The rule Phase 08 must obey, stored with the split so it cannot be forgotten: feature-normalisation statistics are computed per fold on the TRAIN participants of that fold only, never on val, never on test, never on the whole dataset.

rationale.description: Why this n_test and this K for this P (ADR-0021), including the statistical-weakness caveat for small P.
